name: kids-world
description: A cozy 3D block-building island game for kids, to play together in the browser.

paragraphs: A cozy 3D block-building island game for kids, to play together in the browser. Build with toy bricks, raise hills, put up huge tents, plant fruit trees, grow carrots, strawberries and pumpkins on a farm of your own, dig for jewels in the mines, invite bunnies and ducks to move in, bring a pet of your own everywhere you go, ride ponies, elephants, unicorns and dolphins, drive a car, a boat, a digger and a mine cart, scoot about on a kick scooter, take your friends along in a bus or a ferry, fly a helicopter and a hot-air balloon, sit down to a tea party together, play mini-games together at a…
features: Press Make an island, pick a kind of island (Sunny, Snowy, Candy, Volcano or Flat Land) and how big it is (Cozy, Big or Huge), and name it: type any name, or roll one with 🎲. Turn on ⚔️ Adventure for monster camps to…

Tell a friend your six-digit island code (it's at the top of the screen). They press Visit a friend and type it in, or pick your island from 🌍 Islands open now under it. Up to 8 players can be on one island together.

Build together. Your island is saved on your device, and My islands opens it again later. While the island keeper is online, it keeps a copy too, and 🔑 Log in brings you and your islands to your other devices.
Build with 16 colours of toy bricks, plus grass, sand, snow, wood, glass, lamps, star blocks, tent cloth, cookies, candy canes, flowers and more. There are over 90 blocks and plants in the toy box.
Tools: Build, Pick up, Paint and Hills (raise, dig or flatten the land), each in three sizes, and Undo.

It's on the title screen, in ⭐ Stickers, and on the 🛒 button on an island (except on a phone held upright); your coins, potions and gear come along to every island, and with a login to your other devices too.
